long_biography.plain_text:
Buying Toyota Village from Morris Bregman in 1988 gave Jack Antwerpen a proven Maryland dealership to develop. Six years later, he acquired a failing Dodge site in Randallstown and rapidly rebuilt its sales. He then constructed adjoining Dodge and Toyota dealerships in Clarksville, establishing an acquisition-and-development pattern that expanded the group beyond one franchise.

Antwerpen used separate companies to own dealership properties and operating businesses across the Baltimore region. He remained directly identified as principal and owner while managers ran individual sites. Current locations stretch from Baltimore and Clarksville to Eldersburg and Pasadena, pairing separate franchise operations with central group branding.
